title: Detection of Palmitoylation in High-Molecular-Weight Rat Synaptic Proteins
author: Yucel, Henley, et al.

steps.title: Coat plates with poly‑L‑lysine
steps.instruction: In a laminar flow cabinet, add 1 mL of 0.5 mg/mL poly‑L‑lysine (PLL) diluted in borate buffer to each well of a 6‑well plate, incubate 24 h at 37 °C/5 % CO₂, wash three times with 1 mL cell‑culture‑grade water, then add 1.5 mL plating media per well and keep at 37 °C/5 % CO₂ until neurons are plated.

steps.title: Dissect embryonic rat cortex
steps.instruction: Sterilize tools and bench with 70 % ethanol, anaesthetize a pregnant Han Wistar rat (embryonic day E17) with isoflurane and sacrifice by cervical dislocation, sterilize abdomen with 70 % ethanol, make a vertical incision through the linea alba, remove the uterus with embryos, keep embryos in Hank’s Buffered Saline Solution (HBSS) at room temperature, decapitate embryos, extract brains under a dissecting microscope, remove meninges, dissect out the cortex and place each piece into a 35‑mm dish containing HBSS.

steps.title: Enzymatic digestion and washing
steps.instruction: Transfer dissected cortices to a 50 mL Falcon tube, gently score the tissue with a sterile scalpel, wash three times with 30 mL HBSS (allow pellet to settle by gravity), aspirate supernatant, then incubate cortices for 15 min in 30 mL HBSS containing 0.005 % trypsin/EDTA in a 37 °C water bath, inverting tubes gently every ~3 min.

steps.title: Wash and dissociate cells
steps.instruction: Wash cortices three times with 30 mL HBSS followed by one wash with 5 mL plating media, aspirate all liquid, add 5 mL plating media, and triturate with a 5 mL serological pipette on a Pipetboy by pressing the tip against the tube bottom and performing ~14 up‑and‑down strokes to obtain a single‑cell suspension.

steps.title: Count cells and seed neurons
steps.instruction: Dilute the cell suspension with plating medium to a final volume of 20 mL, pass the suspension through a 70 µm cell strainer into a new sterile 50 mL Falcon tube, count cells with a hemocytometer, and seed 500 000 cells per well of the PLL‑coated 6‑well plates in 1.5 mL plating media; incubate at 37 °C/5 % CO₂ (culture period ≈2 days before downstream assays).

steps.title: Feed neuronal cultures
steps.instruction: Two hours after seeding, replace plating media with 2 mL feeding media and return plates to a 37 °C/5 % CO₂ incubator; after 7 days, add an additional 1 mL feeding media and continue incubation until experiments are performed.

steps.title: Optional lentiviral transduction
steps.instruction: Thaw lentiviral aliquots stored at –80 °C in a 37 °C water bath, transduce neurons with KD‑rescue lentivirus expressing YFP‑myc‑GluK2 or the non‑palmitoylatable mutant YFP‑myc‑GluK2‑C858A/C871A, and maintain cells for 7 days in a 37 °C/5 % CO₂ incubator before downstream experiments.

steps.title: Quantify palmitoylation bands
steps.instruction: Acquire images on a LI‑COR Odyssey, quantify pixel intensity of each protein band using Image Studio Lite v5.2, calculate palmitoylated‑band intensity by subtracting background × area from the main band, copy values to Microsoft Excel, and normalize each palmitoylated band to its corresponding native (non‑palmitoylated) band.
